about: The business areas Skill and Folder Map OS starts with. The scan copies these into data/skillmap.json the first time. Change the wording there (or in the app's Preferences), not here. Each 'ideas' line is something a skill could do in that area, shown on the Gaps page when the area has none.

areas.label: Sales
areas.blurb: Finding customers, talking to them and closing the deal.
ideas: Prepare you for every sales call
Chase quotes that have gone quiet
Write up each call and set the next step

areas.label: Marketing
areas.blurb: Getting noticed: posts, emails, the website and ads.
ideas: Plan and draft a week of posts in your voice
Turn a finished job into a case study
Write the monthly newsletter

areas.label: Client delivery
areas.blurb: Doing the work you sold, to the standard you promised.
ideas: Run the same kick-off for every new client
Write the update each client gets
Check the work against your own checklist

areas.label: Money and admin
areas.blurb: Invoices, chasing payment, expenses and the paperwork.
ideas: Draft polite reminders for late invoices
Sort receipts and expenses each week
Summarise what is owed to you

areas.label: People and team
areas.blurb: Hiring, onboarding, rotas, holidays and team updates.
ideas: Draft job adverts and screening questions
Onboard a new starter step by step
Write the weekly team update

areas.label: Customer service
areas.blurb: Answering questions, fixing problems and keeping customers happy.
ideas: Draft replies to the questions you get most
Spot a customer who is about to leave
Log and follow up every complaint

areas.label: Running the business
areas.blurb: Planning, meetings, decisions and keeping the wheels turning.
ideas: Plan your week from your calendar and tasks
Write up every meeting with actions
Prepare for a monthly review
